capabilities: Convert linked .tif/.tiff files to .png copies and rename the links
Revert links to .tif/.tiff and delete the generated .png copies
Convert single files via a file-explorer context menu command
Optionally run conversion automatically when a file is opened
disambiguation: Not a native TIFF renderer; it works by creating PNG copies of TIFF files and pointing links at those copies.
extras: Includes two debug commands, one of which deletes all .tif(f).png files in the vault and is flagged as dangerous.
problem: Obsidian cannot display TIFF images because browsers do not support the format natively.
summary: Converts .tif/.tiff files linked in a note into .png copies and rewrites the links so the images display in Obsidian.
